repos_data.description: A local-first cognitive substrate for neurodivergent professionals. Gives Claude memory, a sense of time, a translator for corporate ambiguity, and a guardrail that refuses to amplify rumination, hyperfocus, or sycophancy. MCP-native. No telemetry. AGPL-3.0-or-later. Self-ID sufficient — no diagnosis gating.

Open-source (AGPL v3) personal finance app with a first-party MCP server. Track your money here, analyze it anywhere — query your finances from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client. Self-host with Docker or use the free cloud.
Always-on context for AI agents: screen capture, OCR, voice, MCP server. Local-first, AGPL-3.0.
